aiNotice.title: Use of AI in this recruitment
aiNotice.body: If you opt in, your CV will be analysed by Claude (Anthropic, USA) to extract a structured profile and produce a candidate-job match score. Recommendations are advisory only — the hiring decision is always made by a human recruiter. Legal basis: explicit consent (RODO art. 6(1)(a) + 22(2)(c)). Transfer to USA: EU-US Data Privacy Framework. You may withdraw consent at any time from your tracking page; withdrawal will stop all future AI processing.
aiNotice.consentLabel: I agree to have my CV processed by AI (Claude / Anthropic) for the purposes of profile enrichment and candidate-job matching. This is optional — I can still apply without it.
aiNotice.optOutHint: If you leave this unchecked, your CV will be parsed only by a local regex-based parser. No data will be sent to Anthropic.
aiNotice.learnMore: Learn more about AI in this hiring process →
